messages.text: Cloud Sync replicates your entire environment — sessions, keys, TOTP, credential sets, and prefs — across every device. Settings → Data → Cloud Sync.
Every connection — terminal, SFTP, tunnels, jump hosts — verifies the server's host key on first use and hard-refuses a changed key. No silent MITM path.
Share a live terminal session read-only in a browser — great for pairing or support, no extra software needed on the viewer's end.
Automate repetitive workflows with the Macro Scripting DSL — send, expect prompts, sleep, and emit progress, all without leaving the terminal.
Browse pods and exec into containers directly — pick a context, namespace, and pod, and secureSH bridges the shell for you. Requires kubectl.
The Monitor panel shows live CPU, RAM, disk, and network graphs for any session — plus a process list where you can kill a runaway PID directly.
The Tunnel Manager tracks every Local/Remote/SOCKS5 tunnel across all sessions in one panel — start, pause, or stop without hunting for the right tab.
Save your whole multi-pane layout — which sessions, which split, which ratios — as a Workspace, and restore it in one click next time.
Record a terminal session and play it back later — useful for audits, incident review, or building a runbook from what you actually typed.
Store TOTP secrets in secureSH and inject the code directly into a login prompt — one less app to unlock when you're already mid-connection.
Credential Sets inject env vars or secrets into a session without ever touching the clipboard — Ctrl+Shift+K from any terminal tab.
Secure Input Mode (Ctrl+Shift+H) types a password into the remote shell with local echo suppressed — nothing lands in scrollback or history.
Run the same command across multiple sessions at once and diff the output side-by-side — spot config drift between servers in seconds.
Two-pane SFTP puts local and remote side by side, with inline diff against a local file and auto-reupload when you save an edit.
Chain through multiple bastion hosts to reach a server buried behind several jumps — each hop gets its own auth method and host-key check.
Launch RDP or VNC sessions straight from the sidebar alongside your SSH connections — one place for every way you reach a box.
Migrating from PuTTY or MobaXterm? Import your existing sessions directly — you'll get a preview before anything is written.
secureSH now has a mobile companion app for iOS and Android — same vault, same sessions, biometric unlock built in.
The ssh-sh CLI companion connects to your saved sessions straight from a terminal — no GUI required, same vault under the hood.
Built-in Network Tools cover IP lookup, whois, SSL certificate checks, and subnet calculations — no need to leave the app for basic diagnostics.
